items.headline: QB Baker accounts for 5 TDs in Louisiana Tech romp over Arkansas State 48-3
items.description: — Blake Baker threw for 291 yards and a career-high four touchdowns and Louisiana Tech beat Arkansas State 48-3 on Saturday night to remain unbeaten in Sun Belt Conference play.

items.headline: Blake Baker, Jordan McRae, Jadon Mayfield spark Louisiana Tech to 63-31 romp over Southern Miss
items.description: — Blake Baker threw three touchdown passes and Jordan McRae and Jadon Mayfield both returned an interception for back-to-back scores as Louisiana Tech steamrolled Southern Mississippi 63-31 on Saturday night.
